title: King of Zugzwang
reviewNotes: Montages, captions and native complete diagrams reviewed. Conditional eleven-piece mate only, after Qb7 at72 seconds: White Ke4/Bf3/Nc6/a3/b2/c5 against Kc8/Qb7/a5/b3/c7. Native26 establishes the complete board and native27 illustrates Bg4 mate. Black a5 belongs to this earlier diagram; it must not be spliced with the later a4 zugzwang position. Bg4# is certified as actual mate. This does not prove the full Ne5/Nc6/Ke3/Bg2/Kd2 queen-confinement plan, force Qb7, or certify the later ten-piece conversion after a queen fork. Previous full legal reconstruction and review history remain preserved.
